info.name: Legal-AI Backend
info.description:
All Legal-AI backend APIs. base_url currently points to http://localhost:5000/api/v1 (working locally together in the office) — change it to https://legal-ai-backend-g86o.onrender.com/api/v1 once you're back on the live deployment. Run requests top-to-bottom inside each folder — tokens/IDs are captured automatically into collection variables via the Tests tab, so you do not need to copy-paste anything manually.

Before running Admin requests: an admin account (9000000099) already exists — created via `npm run create:admin -- 9000000099 "Admin Name"` on whichever backend you're pointed at.

Static OTP for every mobile number (dev only) is 123456 (see {{otp}} variable).

request.description: No auth. Confirms server is up and DB is connected.
Change {{user_mobile}} to a fresh 10-digit number if you get a 409 later (number already signed up).
Response field is always 'token'; tokenType tells you which kind: 'registration' (signup only) or 'access' (everything else).
isNewUser will now be false, tokenType will be 'access' directly (no registration step).
All fields optional (name, email, city) — send at least one. Works for both user and lawyer roles.

multipart/form-data, field name must be 'photo'. Click the field's value box in Postman and pick a JPG/PNG/WEBP file (max 5MB) — 'src' can't be pre-filled from a collection file. Works for both user and lawyer roles.
Stateless JWT: server has nothing to invalidate, so this just confirms the token is valid. Actual logout = the app deletes the token from local storage.

iAmA: 'Practicing lawyer' | 'Retired judge'.
practiceArea: 'Criminal' | 'Family' | 'Corporate & Civil' | 'Judicial'.
canAccessHome should be false and approvalStatus should be 'pending' until an admin approves.

This mobile number must already exist as role=admin. Create it once from the terminal:
npm run create:admin -- 9000000099 "Admin Name"
status can be: pending | approved | rejected. Omit the query param to list all.
New categories appear in GET /practice-areas (public) immediately — no app update needed.
Deactivated areas disappear from the public list and are rejected on new lawyer signups, but existing lawyers who already had this value keep it.
Run 'Auth - User' folder first so {{userId}} is set. Optional filters (enable as needed): role (user|lawyer|admin), isBlocked (true|false), search (name/mobile/email).
Blocks immediately — the user's existing token stops working on the very next request, and they cannot log in again until unblocked. Admin accounts cannot be blocked.

URL day is mon | tue | wed | thu | fri | sat | sun — one endpoint per day, each set independently. This is purely a display time range for the 'Set availability' screen — it is NOT linked to the fixed booking TIME_SLOTS (10:00 AM, 11:30 AM, 2:00 PM, 4:30 PM). Changes are visible immediately on the public GET /working-hours below.
Puts Saturday back to the seeded default so re-running this collection doesn't drift the shared database.
Includes inactive amounts too, unlike the public list below.
New amounts appear in GET /wallet/preset-amounts (public) immediately, sorted ascending.
Deactivated amounts disappear from the public quick-select list but the record stays (can be reactivated).
razorpayKeySecret is never returned by any endpoint, even to admin — only isRazorpayKeySecretSet (true/false) tells you whether one is stored.

⚠️ Replace the placeholder values below with your real Razorpay test keys before running this — the Wallet folder's Create/Verify Recharge requests need real ones to actually hit Razorpay. Running this with the placeholders as-is will OVERWRITE any real credentials already configured, breaking recharges until an admin sets the real ones again. Either field can be sent alone to rotate just that one.
Public, no auth. Powers the quick-select amount buttons on the 'My Wallet' add-money screen. Admin-managed — see the Admin folder to add/deactivate amounts.

Public, no auth. Gives the app just the Razorpay key id (never the secret — that never leaves the server) so it can initialize the Checkout SDK, e.g. at app startup, without needing to create an order first. isPaymentGatewayConfigured is false if the admin hasn't set credentials yet.
Run the 'Auth - User' folder first so {{userToken}} is set.

Creates a real Razorpay order (test mode) and returns { orderId, amount, currency, keyId }. Hand these to the app's Razorpay Checkout SDK — the 'Payment Information' screen (GPay/UPI/Cards) is Razorpay's own UI, not ours. Requires Razorpay credentials to already be set via Admin > Set Payment Settings, otherwise this returns 503.

In the real app, Razorpay Checkout hands back razorpay_payment_id and razorpay_signature once the user actually pays — Postman can't complete that UI step, so this exact call will return 400 (signature mismatch) unless you paste in real values from a completed test payment. The server recomputes the signature itself using the key secret (never exposed by any API) and only credits the wallet if it matches — this is what actually verified the flow, not this Postman request in isolation.
Run 'Auth - User' first so {{userToken}} is set. Returns the Kit token the app initializes ZegoUIKitPrebuiltCallInvitationService with — never a raw AppSign/ServerSecret.

mode: 'voice' | 'video'. Run 'Auth - Lawyer' first so {{lawyerProfileId}} is set, and give that lawyer a callFeePerMinute via PATCH /lawyers/me/call-fee-per-minute — otherwise this returns allowed:false, reason:'no_call_rate_set'. Always HTTP 200 even when not allowed; check data.allowed.

Called right before sending the ZEGOCLOUD invitation. Creates a 'pending' CallSession — billing does NOT start here. It starts only once ZEGOCLOUD's own room_create webhook confirms the call actually connected (see the backend doc's §4) — this endpoint just registers which room to watch for.

Poll this every ~5s while a call is on screen. Right after step 3, expect status:'pending' — it only flips to 'ongoing' once the real ZEGOCLOUD room_create webhook arrives, which Postman can't trigger (that requires an actual call to connect, or a hand-crafted signed webhook — see the backend doc's §4 for the signature algorithm if you need to simulate one directly against the server).

Call this immediately when a call is declined, unanswered, or cancelled before pickup — cases where ZEGOCLOUD never creates a room, so no webhook would ever arrive to end it otherwise. Always bills ₹0 in that case. Safe to call even for a call that DID connect (settles using real elapsed time, same as the webhook path) and safe to call twice (idempotent).

Public, no auth. One entry per weekday (Mon..Sun) with an admin-set startTime/endTime — powers the time range text shown on the lawyer's 'Set availability' screen. Seeded once via `npm run seed:working-hours` (defaults to 10:00 AM - 6:00 PM for every day), then edited per-day from the Admin folder above.
Public, no auth. Powers the lawyer-signup dropdown and the 'Find a lawyer' filter chips. Admin-managed — see the Admin folder to add/deactivate categories.
Public, no auth. Only approvalStatus=approved lawyers are returned. Run this AFTER approving a lawyer in the Admin folder.
practiceArea: Criminal | Family | Corporate & Civil | Judicial
Matches against lawyer name, practiceArea, and cityJurisdiction.

request.description: The single 'Edit Profile' call for a lawyer — name/email update the User doc, everything else updates LawyerProfile, in one request. All fields optional, send at least one. availabilityStatus: 'Available' | 'Busy'. pricePerSession bills a Chat/fixed session; callFeePerMinute bills Audio/Video by the minute. profilePhotoUrl, casesHandled and consultsCount are read-only here — set via /auth/me/photo or managed by the system.
Read-only for now — the write/submit review API will come once the booking-completion flow exists, so this list stays empty until then.
One endpoint per type (chat | audio | video) — toggled independently, so a lawyer can turn off Video while keeping Chat and Audio on. Booking a disabled type is rejected with a 400.
Restores the default so the Booking folder below (which books Chat) is unaffected either way — run this to confirm the flag flips back too.
Dedicated endpoint for just this one field — an alternative to sending it inside the combined PATCH /lawyers/me body. Bills a Chat / fixed session.
Dedicated endpoint for just this one field. Bills Audio/Video consultations by the minute.
Returns which weekdays (Mon..Sun) this lawyer currently accepts bookings on. Defaults to all 7 until set.

Send the full set of days to keep on (not a single-day toggle) — a day left out is blocked from new bookings, and GET /lawyers/:id/availability?date= will show that whole day as unavailable. Empty array is valid (fully off, e.g. on leave). The time range shown next to each day on the 'Set availability' screen comes from GET /working-hours (admin-set, same for every lawyer) — this endpoint only stores which days this lawyer personally works.
Fixed slots for every lawyer: 10:00 AM, 11:30 AM, 2:00 PM, 4:30 PM. isAvailable=false means someone already holds that slot. Set {{booking_date}} to a future YYYY-MM-DD.
consultationType: 'Chat' | 'Audio' | 'Video'. Booking is created with status 'pending_payment'; the lawyer must have a pricePerSession set first.
Stands in for the real payment gateway callback until Razorpay (or similar) is integrated. Flips status pending_payment -> confirmed.
